title: Beyond Majority Voting: Agreement-Based Clustering to Model Annotator Perspectives in Subjective NLP Tasks
reasoning: The paper focuses on a methodological approach to model annotator disagreement in subjective NLP tasks. While it acknowledges that sociodemographic factors like religiosity influence perspectives and addresses the potential for marginalizing minority viewpoints (fairness), it does not explicitly evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethical systems as a core component of its research.
